items.title: 日本3月机床订单额增长28% 海外订单增40%
items.raw_excerpt: 日本工作机械工业会4月9日发布的数据显示，3月机床订单额达1935亿日元，同比增长28%。已连续9个月实现同比增长。尽管市场担忧3月中东局势恶化会对设备投资造成影响，但据日工会负责人介绍，3月订单额创下历史新高。海外订单大幅增长40%至1430亿日元。在汽车、人工智能（AI）等广泛领域取得了订单。

title_i18n.zh: 日本3月机床订单额增长28% 海外订单增40%
title_i18n.en: Japan's March machine tool orders increased by 28%, with overseas orders rising by 40%.
title_i18n.es: Las órdenes de máquinas herramienta de Japón aumentaron un 28% en marzo, con un incremento del 40% en pedidos del extranjero.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 日本工作机械工业会4月9日发布的数据显示，3月机床订单额达1935亿日元，同比增长28%。已连续9个月实现同比增长。尽管市场担忧3月中东局势恶化会对设备投资造成影响，但据日工会负责人介绍，3月订单额创下历史新高。海外订单大幅增长40%至1430亿日元。在汽车、人工智能（AI）等广泛领域取得了订单。
excerpt_i18n.en: According to data released by the Japan Machine Tool Builders' Association on April 9, machine tool orders in March reached 193.5 billion yen, a year-on-year increase of 28%. This marks the ninth consecutive month of year-on-year growth. Despite market concerns that the deteriorating situation in the Middle East in March might impact equipment investment, the association's representative noted that March orders hit a record high. Overseas orders surged by 40% to 143 billion yen, with orders secured across a wide range of sectors including automotive and artificial intelligence (AI).
excerpt_i18n.es: Según datos publicados el 9 de abril por la Asociación Japonesa de Fabricantes de Máquinas Herramienta, las órdenes de máquinas herramienta en marzo alcanzaron los 193.500 millones de yenes, un aumento del 28% interanual. Esto marca el noveno mes consecutivo de crecimiento interanual. A pesar de la preocupación en el mercado por el impacto que el deterioro de la situación en Oriente Medio en marzo podría tener en la inversión en equipos, el responsable de la asociación señaló que las órdenes de marzo alcanzaron un récord histórico. Las órdenes del extranjero aumentaron significativamente un 40%, hasta los 143.000 millones de yenes. Se recibieron pedidos en una amplia gama de sectores, como la automoción y la inteligencia artificial (IA).

items.title: I visualized how AI agent systems accidentally become org charts
items.raw_excerpt: Most companies deploying AI agents are accidentally building organizations. You start with one agent. It gets overwhelmed. You add more. They start routing to each other based on what works. Repeated behavior hardens into structure. Someone introduces an orchestrator to bring order. Some agents never get the memo. Some lose context when they get replaced. The orchestrator doesn't know what it doesn't know. This is what is happening in most engineering organizations right now So, I built an interactive visualization that walks through how this happens in six acts, from a single agent to a full emergent org chart. The visual starts center-out and transitions to a top-down hierarchy as structure forms. Failing agents flicker. Connections break. The orchestrator arrives and things look better

title_i18n.en: I visualized how AI agent systems accidentally become org charts
title_i18n.zh: 我设想了AI代理系统如何意外演变为组织结构图。
title_i18n.es: Visualicé cómo los sistemas de agentes de IA se convierten accidentalmente en organigramas.

excerpt_i18n.en: Most companies deploying AI agents are accidentally building organizations. You start with one agent. It gets overwhelmed. You add more. They start routing to each other based on what works. Repeated behavior hardens into structure. Someone introduces an orchestrator to bring order. Some agents never get the memo. Some lose context when they get replaced. The orchestrator doesn't know what it doesn't know. This is what is happening in most engineering organizations right now So, I built an interactive visualization that walks through how this happens in six acts, from a single agent to a full emergent org chart. The visual starts center-out and transitions to a top-down hierarchy as structure forms. Failing agents flicker. Connections break. The orchestrator arrives and things look better
excerpt_i18n.zh: 大多数部署人工智能代理的公司，无意中都在构建组织。起初只有一个代理，它不堪重负，于是你增加更多。它们开始根据有效经验相互路由，重复行为逐渐固化。
excerpt_i18n.es: La mayoría de las empresas que despliegan agentes de IA están construyendo organizaciones por accidente. Comienzas con un agente. Se ve desbordado. Añades más. Empiezan a dirigirse entre sí según lo que funciona. El comportamiento repetido solidifica las estructuras.

items.title: 从汽车到物理 AI：何小鹏眼中的智能汽车下半场
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，2026 款小鹏 MONA M03 正式上市。这场以年轻化为主题的发布会，表面是一款主力车型的年度迭代，内里暗含了小鹏集团战略转向的集中呈现。 在发布会后的媒体群访中，何小鹏系统阐述了对行业周期、技术范式、盈利模式、竞争格局与未来形态的判断，其观点不仅关乎小鹏自身，更折射出中国智能电动汽车产业在 AI 驱动下的集体转向。 更名背后：从 “造车” 到 “物理 AI 科技集团” 的认知跃迁 3 月 27 日，小鹏汽车公告自 4 月 1 日起更名为 “小鹏集团”，这一变更被何小鹏定义为 “过去十年与未来十年的分界点”。在他看来，这不是简单的品牌调整，而是对行业本质与企业定位的重新定义 ——汽车行业正在从新能源硬件竞赛，进入 “新能源 + 智能体 + 物理 AI” 叠加的全新十年。 何小鹏明确提出，此前多年外界建议更改 “小鹏” 二字，而最终选择去掉 “汽车”，恰恰说明企业核心业务边界已彻底拓展。过去十年，小鹏的核心是智能电动汽车；未来十年，核心将是物理 AI，即以大模型为底座，通过汽车、机器人、飞行汽车等实体载体，实现对物理世界的感知、理解、决策与执行。 支撑这一判断的，是他对技术节奏的认知。 两三年前，他还认为机器人时代属于下个十年、L5 级自动驾驶十年内难以实现；而过去一年物理 AI 大模型的演进，让他改变判断 ——机器人时代正在加速到来，L5 在十年内具备现实可能性，且机器人的落地条件比无人驾驶更宽松。 这种认知跃迁，直接推动小鹏从单一车型研发，转向 “一栈式技术底座驱动多品类终端” 的架构，自动驾驶、机器人、飞行汽车共享底层模型与算力，技术复用率大幅提升，研发投入的边际效益显著改善。 对于传统汽车商业模式，何小鹏直言不讳：“现在的汽车公司都不是一个好的商业模式，是高度内卷的模式”。 即便行业普遍追求高质量发展，硬件主导的商业模型天然存在天花板，过度依赖产能扩张与价格

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, the 2026 Xiaopeng MONA M03 officially launched. This youth-themed event, while appearing as an annual update of a flagship model, subtly reflects a concentrated shift in Xiaopeng Group's strategic direction. During the post-launch media interview, He Xiaopeng systematically elaborated on his views regarding industry cycles, technological paradigms, profit models, competitive landscapes, and future forms. His insights not only pertain to Xiaopeng itself but also mirror the collective pivot of China's intelligent electric vehicle industry driven by AI.

Behind the Renaming: A Cognitive Leap from "Car Manufacturing" to "Physical AI Technology Group"
On March 27, Xiaopeng Motors announced it would rename itself "Xiaopeng Group" starting April 1. He Xiaopeng defined this change as "the dividing line between the past decade and the next." In his view, this is not merely a brand adjustment but a redefinition of the industry's essence and the company's positioning—the automotive industry is transitioning from a competition in new energy hardware to a new decade characterized by the convergence of "new energy + intelligent agents + physical AI."

He Xiaopeng explicitly stated that while there had been external suggestions over the years to change the name "Xiaopeng," the decision to drop "Motors" instead precisely indicates that the company's core business boundaries have fundamentally expanded. Over the past decade, Xiaopeng's focus was on intelligent electric vehicles; in the next decade, the core will be physical AI—leveraging large models as the foundation to perceive, understand, decide, and act upon the physical world through tangible carriers such as cars, robots, and flying vehicles.

Supporting this judgment is his perspective on technological pace.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, el modelo 2026 del Xpeng MONA M03 se lanzó oficialmente al mercado. Este evento de presentación, centrado en la juventud, aparentemente es una actualización anual de un modelo principal, pero en esencia refleja un cambio estratégico concentrado del Grupo Xpeng. Durante la rueda de prensa posterior al lanzamiento, He Xiaopeng explicó sistemáticamente sus perspectivas sobre el ciclo industrial, los paradigmas tecnológicos, los modelos de rentabilidad, el panorama competitivo y las formas futuras. Sus opiniones no solo conciernen a Xpeng, sino que también reflejan el giro colectivo de la industria china de vehículos eléctricos inteligentes impulsada por la IA.
